set_commonargs: setenv bootargs console=ttyS0,115200n8 earlycon=${earlycon} keep_bootcon ignore_loglevel loglevel=8 init=/linuxrc firmware_class.path=/etc/firmware
nand_boot: echo Boot experimental Linux from NAND; if test ${boot_partition} = kernel; then run set_nand_bootargs; loadknl mtd kernel ${knl_addr}; else run set_nand_bootargs_recovery; loadknl mtd recovery ${knl_addr}; fi; bootm ${knl_addr};
